sample.source: same complete 10-stop, temperature-qualified NAAMP runs and adjacent-observed-year route x RunNumber matched pairs as the ecological pulse analysis
sample.pair_orientation: lower DaysSinceRain = wet; higher DaysSinceRain = dry
sample.stop_alignment: same StopNumber within matched route; fail closed unless all 10 stop numbers align

ecological_question: Does rainfall-associated expansion of route-level active species richness arise because the active spatial footprint expands, because species composition changes within already-active stops, or both?

frozen_primary_endpoints.name: delta_active_stops
frozen_primary_endpoints.definition: number of stops with >=1 calling species in wet run minus dry run

frozen_primary_endpoints.name: shared_species_delta_stops_mean
frozen_primary_endpoints.definition: within each pair, mean wet-minus-dry number of occupied stops among species present somewhere in both runs

frozen_primary_endpoints.name: footprint_dependent_net_species
frozen_primary_endpoints.definition: wet-only route species detected exclusively at stops inactive in the dry run, minus dry-only route species detected exclusively at stops inactive in the wet run
frozen_primary_endpoints.meaning: conservative component of route richness change structurally dependent on expansion/contraction of the active-stop footprint

frozen_primary_endpoints.name: within_footprint_net_species
frozen_primary_endpoints.definition: remaining wet-only route species minus remaining dry-only route species after footprint-dependent species are removed
frozen_primary_endpoints.prediction: reported without a directional support gate
frozen_primary_endpoints.meaning: route richness change occurring at least partly within stops already active in the comparison run

exact_identity: richness_gain = footprint_dependent_net_species + within_footprint_net_species for every matched pair
secondary_diagnostics: 2x2 counts of wet incidence gains: route-new versus route-existing species x dry-inactive versus dry-active stop

model.formula: response ~ rain_contrast + temp_difference + doy_difference + year_gap + C(State) + C(RunNumber)

interpretation_boundary.active: acoustically detected calling activity, not occupancy or abundance
interpretation_boundary.footprint_dependent: structural dependence in the observed stop x species matrix, not causal proof that spatial activation caused species recruitment
interpretation_boundary.rainfall: observational association; no causal rainfall claim
interpretation_boundary.multiplicity: finite decomposition family fixed before endpoint readback; no outcome-dependent retuning
